capabilities: Import external Markdown files or folders recursively into the vault
Resolve relative, absolute, and file:// image paths from the original Markdown folder
Copy images and optional non-image attachments into the configured attachment location
Rewrite image links as standard Markdown while preserving wiki-link and embed syntax for attachments
Preview import counts and issues, then report reused, missing, conflicting, and errored assets
disambiguation: Not a file-syncing tool; it imports external Markdown files once and copies their referenced assets into the vault.
extras: Desktop only and requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later with Node.js filesystem access. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Interface is available in English and Simplified Chinese.
problem: Importing Markdown written outside Obsidian breaks relative image and attachment links, because the vault has no way to resolve them against the source file's original folder.
summary: Markdown importer that copies external .md files into the vault and resolves their local image and attachment links from the files' original disk folders.
